## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`<type>[optional scope][!]: <description>`)
- [ ] The arc42 documentation in `Docs/Architecture` describes the change, or the change does not affect the architecture
- [ ] A hard-to-reverse decision has an ADR in `Docs/Architecture/Architecture-Decisions`
- [ ] Requirement IDs or the issue are referenced (`Closes #…`)
